method.carryForwardRule: Carry a v1 resolution only if exact name/version, raw declared value, packageJsonSha256, full package fingerprint, document path/hash map, prior resolution package identity, and prior resolution package evidence all match the final inventory.
method.noCopying: No third-party package code, license text, or README text is copied to this addendum; only fingerprints, short findings, and file metadata are recorded.
method.readmeInspection: For each unique Anthropic SDK version, inspect one representative exact installed README.md only after resolving the package path beneath its recorded installation root, rejecting symlink components, and bounding file size/read to 65536 bytes. Record the full-file SHA-256 and summarize license-related findings without copying the README.
